# Chirp Platform

## Chirp Wireless Docs

- [Chirp — Home Automation Platform](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/readme.md): Chirp is an AI-first home automation platform — connect any maker's sensors and let a built-in AI helper run the setup.
- [First Steps](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/first-steps.md): Get started with Chirp — what you need and the LoRaWAN setup flow that takes you from unboxing to live sensor data.
- [Finding Your Way Around](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/first-steps/finding-your-way-around.md): Tour the Chirp interface — left menu, profile options, notification bell, home screen — find where everything lives.
- [Connect Your First Sensor](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/first-steps/connect-your-first-sensor.md): Hands-on guide to pair a gateway, register a LoRaWAN sensor, build a room dashboard, and set your first home alarm.
- [Overview](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/overview.md): Read your home at a glance — device and gateway status cards, notifications, and self-refreshing live readings.
- [Dashboards](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards.md): See your whole smart home at a glance — overview, custom dashboards, widgets, maps, and live sensor data.
- [Building a Dashboard](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/building-a-dashboard.md): Create, rename, and delete a personalized Chirp dashboard with its own name, icon, and folder.
- [Adding Widgets](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets.md): Add and configure dashboard widgets — pick a type, connect it to your sensors, and tailor the ranges and colors.
- [Last Data Widget](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/last-data-widget.md): Show the latest value from one or more sensors as a number, gauge, or ring — is the door open, how warm is the room?
- [Value Display](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/last-data-widget/number.md): Show a sensor's latest reading as a number, text, or on/off with the Value display in the Chirp Last Data widget.
- [Doughnut Display](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/last-data-widget/doughnut.md): Show a reading as a filling ring with the number in the middle — perfect for a tank, battery, or humidity level.
- [Pie Display](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/last-data-widget/pie.md): Show a reading as a bold filled circle that fills as the value rises — a chunkier take on the ring gauge.
- [Tube Display](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/last-data-widget/tube.md): Show a level as a filling cylinder, like a real tank — watch the salt, fuel, or rain barrel run low or rise too high.
- [Gauge Display](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/last-data-widget/gauge.md): Put a reading on a horizontal track with a sliding marker and colored bands, so you spot the moment it crosses a limit.
- [Radial Gauge Display](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/last-data-widget/radial-gauge.md): Show a Chirp reading on a round dial with the Radial Gauge — a needle, a sweep angle you choose, and colored zones.
- [Control Widget](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/control-widget.md): Add a Control widget to a Chirp dashboard — a switch, button, slider, or input that operates a device from one tap.
- [Switch](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/control-widget/switch.md): Add a Switch Control to a Chirp dashboard to flip a home device on or off — a lamp, plug, or relay — with one tap.
- [Button](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/control-widget/button.md): Add a Button Control to a Chirp dashboard to run a one-tap device action — restart, run a scene, open — with a press.
- [Simple Slider](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/control-widget/slider-simple.md): Add a Simple Slider to a Chirp dashboard — a horizontal slider that sets a value like brightness by sliding.
- [Circular Slider](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/control-widget/slider-circular.md): Add a Circular Slider to a Chirp dashboard — a round dial that sets a value like color temperature by turning it.
- [Vertical Slider](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/control-widget/slider-vertical.md): Add a Vertical Slider to a Chirp dashboard — an upright slider that sets a value like a level you raise or lower.
- [Input](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/control-widget/input.md): Add an Input Control to a Chirp dashboard to send an exact value, like a thermostat target or color temperature.
- [Text Widget](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/text-widget.md): Add a Text widget to a Chirp dashboard to label and organize your tiles with headings and short notes.
- [Chart Widget](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/chart-widget.md): Graph a reading's history over the hour, day, week, or month with color bands and a live current value.
- [Image Widget](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/image-widget.md): Pin live sensor readings onto your own photo or floor plan, each colored by its conditions, with multi-layer views.
- [Map Widget](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/map-widget.md): Show a GPS device's live position on an outdoor map with one reading on the marker and route history by date.
- [iFrame Widget](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/iframe-widget.md): Drop a live web page — a weather map, live traffic, or your calendar — onto a Chirp dashboard with the iFrame Widget.
- [Digital Building Twin](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/digital-building-twin.md): Build a 3D model of your home and watch it light up with live sensor colors and readings, right on your dashboard.
- [Editor Tour](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/digital-building-twin/editor-tour.md): A quick walk around the 3D home editor — the toolbar, Scene panel, settings, floor buttons, and saving.
- [Drawing Your Home](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/digital-building-twin/drawing-your-building.md): Draw walls, doors, windows, and fences for your 3D home model in a flat 2D or full 3D view.
- [Importing a Floor Plan](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/digital-building-twin/importing-a-dxf-plan.md): Turn a DXF floor plan into walls for your 3D home — set the source unit and preview before importing.
- [Tracing from the Map](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/digital-building-twin/tracing-from-the-map.md): Click your home's outline on a satellite map to turn it into walls and save its real-world location.
- [Floors and Levels](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/digital-building-twin/floors-and-levels.md): Add upstairs, downstairs, and basement levels to your 3D home and switch between stacked and solo floor views.
- [Placing Objects](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/digital-building-twin/placing-objects.md): Drop furniture and objects into your 3D home, turn them as you place, and adjust position, scale, and rotation.
- [Object Library](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/digital-building-twin/object-catalog.md): Browse the 60-plus 3D objects for your home model — furniture, kitchen, bathroom, appliances, and outdoor items.
- [Connecting Sensors and Colors](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/digital-building-twin/binding-sensors-and-colors.md): Link a sensor reading to objects in your 3D home and set color rules so the door, room, or basement reacts live.
- [Pins and Live Readings](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/digital-building-twin/drop-pins-and-live-values.md): Pin a sensor's exact value into your 3D home, colored by its status, and show or hide every pin at once.
- [GPS Anchoring](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/digital-building-twin/gps-anchoring.md): Tie your 3D home model to real latitude and longitude, automatically from a map trace or by hand.
- [Conditions](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/adding-widgets/conditions.md): Set per-metric color rules so a reading turns green, yellow, or red — green for comfortable, red for check it now.
- [Organizing Your Views](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/organizing-your-views.md): Group dashboards into folders and drag-and-drop them so the views you use most sit right at the top.
- [Maps and Device Placement](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/maps-and-device-placement.md): See where each sensor sits in your home on an interactive map and assign a room to put it on the map.
- [Tracking What Matters](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/tracking-what-matters.md): View location history for a GPS tracker — see the route your car, pet, or bike took on any chosen day.
- [Live Home Data](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/dashboards/live-home-data.md): How live sensor updates reach your screen, what the Live Data indicators mean, and what to check if data is missing.
- [Connectors](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/connectors.md): See how connections link your home sensors to Chirp over LoRaWAN, MQTT, or a vehicle tracker.
- [Setting Up a Connection](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/connectors/setting-up-a-connection.md): Create an LNS connection for LoRaWAN sensors or a Tracker connection for your vehicle, in a few clicks.
- [LNS Connector](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/connectors/lns-connector.md): The LNS connector links your LoRaWAN sensors to Chirp's built-in network server — nothing to install.
- [What is LoRaWAN?](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/connectors/lns-connector/what-is-lorawan.md): Learn why LoRaWAN reaches every corner of your home and runs sensors for years on a single battery.
- [LoRaWAN Frequencies](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/connectors/lns-connector/lorawan-frequencies.md): Find the right LoRaWAN frequency band for your country before registering a sensor in Chirp.
- [Built-in Network Server](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/connectors/lns-connector/built-in-lns.md): Chirp's built-in LoRaWAN network server handles sensor authentication and delivery for you automatically.
- [Tracker Connector](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/connectors/tracker-connector.md): Connect a cellular GPS vehicle tracker to Chirp — OBD2, CAN bus, and standalone trackers, 2,000+ preconfigured models.
- [MQTT Connector](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/connectors/mqtt-connector.md): Bring Zigbee sensors, smart plugs, and DIY hardware into your home with the MQTT connector.
- [What MQTT is](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/connectors/mqtt-connector/what-is-mqtt.md): A friendly intro to MQTT brokers, topics, and JSON payloads — the messaging behind the smart home.
- [Cloud MQTT](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/connectors/mqtt-connector/cloud-mqtt.md): The simplest MQTT path — Chirp hosts the broker, you paste the credentials into Zigbee2MQTT and go.
- [External MQTT](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/connectors/mqtt-connector/external-mqtt.md): Point Chirp at a broker you already run at home — set up Mosquitto, expose it safely, and verify it.
- [Topics and Device Routing](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/connectors/mqtt-connector/topics-and-device-routing.md): Read this before registering an MQTT device — how Chirp matches topics to the right sensor in your home.
- [Setting up Zigbee2MQTT](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/connectors/mqtt-connector/zigbee2mqtt.md): Install Zigbee2MQTT to bridge your Zigbee bulbs and sensors into Chirp through the MQTT connector.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/connectors/mqtt-connector/troubleshooting.md): Fix MQTT data that isn't reaching Chirp — empty Logs, topic mismatches, and devices that won't publish.
- [Devices](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/devices.md): Every sensor in your home gets its own profile — name, photos, readings, and full history in one place.
- [Adding Sensors](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/devices/adding-sensors.md): Register a LoRaWAN, tracker, or MQTT sensor in Chirp and map its readings, step by step.
- [Data Templates](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/devices/data-templates.md): Data templates tell Chirp what your sensors measure, so readings show up labeled with the right units.
- [Sensor Details](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/devices/sensor-details.md): Open any sensor to view live readings, edit its settings, and browse its full data history.
- [Rooms](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/devices/rooms.md): Group your sensors into rooms like Living Room, Kitchen, and Garden so everything's easy to find.
- [Favorite Devices](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/devices/favorite-devices.md): Star the devices and gateways you check most in Chirp — saved and shown right on their cards for quick access.
- [Controlling Your Devices](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/devices/commands.md): Control your devices from Chirp — turn things on or off, dim lights, and change color temperature over MQTT or LoRaWAN.
- [Setting up a command](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/devices/commands/creating-commands.md): Set up a device command in Chirp — name it, pick the device, add inputs like brightness, and test before you save.
- [Making sure it worked](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/devices/commands/verification.md): Tell Chirp how to confirm a command really worked — skip the check, wait for the next reading, or ask the device.
- [Sending a command](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/devices/commands/executing-commands.md): Send a command from the States tab in Chirp, fill in any values, and see whether it worked in your activity history.
- [Tested Device Guides](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/devices/tested-device-guides.md): Hands-on walkthroughs for specific sensors and bulbs we paired end-to-end with Chirp at home.
- [Zigbee Devices](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/devices/tested-device-guides/zigbee.md): Zigbee bulbs and sensors we paired through a Zigbee2MQTT hub — pairing quirks and payload details.
- [Paulmann 50064 Light Bulb](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/devices/tested-device-guides/zigbee/paulmann-50064-light-bulb.md): Pair, register, and map the Paulmann 50064 tunable-white Zigbee bulb in Chirp, with all the quirks.
- [Gateways](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/gateways.md): Gateways bring your sensors into Chirp — choose between a LoRaWAN gateway and a Zigbee2MQTT hub.
- [LoRaWAN Gateways](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/gateways/lorawan-gateways.md): One small LoRaWAN gateway covers a whole home — learn how it works and how coverage spreads.
- [Setting Up a LoRaWAN Gateway](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/gateways/lorawan-gateways/setting-up-a-lorawan-gateway.md): Register your home gateway in Chirp, download its security certificate, and get it online in minutes.
- [Checking LoRaWAN Gateway Health](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/gateways/lorawan-gateways/checking-lorawan-gateway-health.md): Check whether your home gateway is online, see its uptime, and know when a dip is worth a look.
- [Compatible LoRaWAN Gateways](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/gateways/lorawan-gateways/compatible-lorawan-gateways.md): What to look for when buying a LoRaWAN gateway for your home — Basics Station, band, and placement.
- [Zigbee2MQTT Hubs](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/gateways/zigbee2mqtt-hubs.md): A Zigbee2MQTT hub — a small computer plus a coordinator — brings your Zigbee devices into Chirp.
- [Sonoff ZBDongle-E Coordinator](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/gateways/zigbee2mqtt-hubs/sonoff-zbdongle-e-coordinator.md): Plug in the Sonoff ZBDongle-E, confirm Linux sees it, and get ready to run your Zigbee2MQTT hub.
- [Alarm](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/alarm.md): See how Chirp turns sensor readings into home alerts, with an Inbox, alarm rules, and contact settings.
- [Set Up a Home Alert](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/alarm/set-up-a-home-alert.md): Create an alarm definition that sets severity, channels, schedule, and message for a home alert.
- [Escalation Chains](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/alarm/escalation-chains.md): Build a step-by-step chain so an unresolved home alert reaches more people until someone responds.
- [Notification Severity](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/alarm/notification-severity.md): Set the five severity levels and choose how often each one re-sends a reminder while an alarm stays active.
- [Check and Clear Alerts](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/alarm/check-and-clear-alerts.md): Review what fired in your Inbox, filter by severity or status, and resolve home alerts to stop escalation.
- [Manage Contact Methods](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/alarm/manage-contact-methods.md): Add and verify email and SMS contacts, then choose which channels deliver your home alerts.
- [Chirp Alerts App](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/alarm/chirp-alerts-app.md): Get Chirp alerts on your phone with the IoT Alerts app — critical alarms ring until you respond.
- [Getting Started](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/alarm/chirp-alerts-app/getting-started.md): Install IoT Alerts, pick Home Use, sign in to Chirp, and get your phone ready for alerts.
- [Alert Behavior](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/alarm/chirp-alerts-app/alert-behavior.md): Which alerts ring through on silent and which arrive quietly — set by the severity you choose.
- [Managing Alerts](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/alarm/chirp-alerts-app/managing-alerts.md): View, resolve, and quiet your home alerts from the app's Inbox and Alert Definitions tabs.
- [Rules engine](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/rules-engine.md): Let your home act on its own — automations that watch your sensors and respond, from an alert to flipping a switch.
- [Your First Automation](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/rules-engine/your-first-automation.md): A ten-minute tutorial to build your first automation — a basement humidity alert, from blank canvas to working rule.
- [Create an Automation](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/rules-engine/your-first-automation/create-an-automation.md): Open the editor, name your automation, pick the sensor that triggers it, and save your first draft.
- [Add Conditions and Branches](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/rules-engine/your-first-automation/add-conditions-and-branches.md): Add a Script Task and a gateway so your automation classifies a reading and sends it down the right path.
- [Trigger Alarms and Actions](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/rules-engine/your-first-automation/trigger-alarms-and-actions.md): Add a Set Alarm node and a motivation message so your automation notifies you when the basement gets too humid.
- [Going Deeper](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/rules-engine/going-deeper.md): Go beyond single-sensor rules — pull in other sensors, do the math, and publish automations that run live.
- [Data Enrichment and Expressions](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/rules-engine/going-deeper/data-enrichment-and-expressions.md): Combine readings from several sensors, transform them with CEL, and handle offline sensors with a fallback path.
- [Publish and Run](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/rules-engine/going-deeper/publish-and-run-an-automation.md): Take an automation live — build it, deploy the artifact, stop it when needed, and read the Artifacts tab.
- [Managing Automations](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/rules-engine/managing-automations.md): Stay in control of your automations — version history, editing locks, trash, and easy recovery when you need it.
- [View, Edit, and Locks](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/rules-engine/managing-automations/view-edit-and-locks.md): See how view and edit modes work, how locks stop household members clashing, and how autosave protects you.
- [History, Restore, and Recovery](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/rules-engine/managing-automations/history-restore-and-recovery.md): Browse every saved version of an automation, name your milestones, and roll back to a known-good version anytime.
- [Trash and Restore](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/rules-engine/managing-automations/trash-and-restore.md): Deleted an automation by mistake? It waits in the Trash — find it, bring it back, and learn how long it's kept.
- [Examples](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/rules-engine/examples.md): Ready-to-adapt smart home automation ideas for comfort, energy, and safety — copy a pattern and make it your own.
- [Home Comfort and Energy](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/rules-engine/examples/home-comfort-and-energy.md): Build automations that keep rooms comfortable — temperature zones, garden moisture, and wine cellar climate alerts.
- [Safety and Alerting](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/rules-engine/examples/safety-and-alerting.md): Catch trouble fast with leak, door, garage, and freezer automations that alert the moment something looks wrong.
- [Reference](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/rules-engine/reference.md): Look up how nodes, CEL expressions, the visual editor, and build errors work when building home automations.
- [Rules Page and Tabs](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/rules-engine/reference/rules-page-and-tabs.md): A tour of the Rules page — the Rules, Artifacts, and Trash tabs, plus the actions on each automation row.
- [Visual Editor](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/rules-engine/reference/visual-editor.md): Find your way around the automation editor — the header bar, canvas, node palette, and properties sidebar.
- [Debugging Automations](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/rules-engine/reference/debugging-automations.md): Step through an automation with debug mode — feed it a test reading, set breakpoints, and watch the values change.
- [Automation Node Guide](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/rules-engine/reference/automation-node-guide.md): Every automation node — Gateway, Script Task, Set Alarm, Execute Command, Enrichment — its fields and runtime behavior.
- [When an Automation Runs a Command](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/rules-engine/reference/automation-runs-a-command.md): Let a Chirp automation act on its own — the Execute Command step sends a device a command when conditions are met.
- [CEL for Home Automations](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/rules-engine/reference/cel-for-home-automations.md): A friendly CEL guide for home rules — sensor variables, comparisons, math, text, and building clear alarm messages.
- [Fixing Builds and Runtime Stops](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/rules-engine/reference/fixing-builds-and-runtime-stops.md): Decode build errors, understand deploy and stop, and recover an automation that the system force-stopped.
- [AI Assistant](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/ai-assistant.md): The Chirp AI Helper knows your home and sets up sensors, automations, and alerts for you — all in plain language.
- [Talking to Your Home](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/ai-assistant/talking-to-your-home.md): Ask the Chirp AI Helper about your home — live readings, history, and charts — plus tips for the best answers.
- [Let the Helper Set It Up](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/ai-assistant/let-ai-set-it-up.md): Have the Chirp AI Helper add a sensor, build an automation, or create an alert from a plain-language chat.
- [What It Knows](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/ai-assistant/what-it-knows.md): What the Chirp AI Helper can see — your live sensors, full history, and help guides, always limited to your home.
- [Your Chats and Your Own AI](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/ai-assistant/chats-and-your-own-ai.md): Start a new chat, find past conversations, see how many requests you have left, and connect your own AI key in Chirp.
- [Your Privacy](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/ai-assistant/your-privacy.md): How the Chirp AI Helper stays private — it works within your access, asks before big changes, never stores passwords.
- [Reports](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/reports.md): Track who has access to your Chirp home — invitations, joins, permission changes, and removals in one activity record.
- [Activity Log](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/reports/audit-trail.md): See and filter every membership change in your Chirp home — invites, joins, permission updates, and removals.
- [API](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/api.md): Get programmatic access to your home's sensor data for scripts, spreadsheets, and smart-home integrations.
- [REST API](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/api/public-rest-api.md): Connect your scripts and tools to Chirp over HTTPS with a scoped API key — manage sensors, dashboards, and automations.
- [gRPC API](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/api/grpc-api.md): Learn when the advanced gRPC interface is worth it over REST for typed, on-premise Chirp integrations.
- [Authentication & API Keys](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/api/authentication-and-api-keys.md): Sign every Chirp API request with a scoped key and home header, and keep keys narrow with scopes.
- [Examples](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/api/examples.md): Follow a working curl example to sign a Chirp REST request and list the sensors a key can see.
- [Settings](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/settings.md): Manage your profile, sensor rooms and locations, and API keys from the Chirp Settings section.
- [Profile](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/settings/profile-settings.md): Update the name and photo other household members see, and review your account email in Chirp.
- [Rooms and Locations](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/settings/locations.md): Organize sensors by room and area to mirror your home, making dashboards and readings easier to find.
- [API Keys](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/settings/api-keys.md): Create scoped API keys to connect Chirp to your scripts and tools, and revoke or rotate them anytime.
- [Help](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/get-help.md): Reach the Chirp support team — fill out the built-in contact form with your subject, email, and details.
- [Account](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/account.md): Manage household members, your subscription, and home settings from the user menu in Chirp.
- [Subscription](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/account/subscription.md): Pick a Chirp plan, see what each tier includes, upgrade or manage billing, and top up SMS credits — all in one place.
- [Household Members](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/account/users-and-permissions.md): Set per-section access for every household member so each person sees only what matters to them.
- [Inviting Members](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/account/inviting-members.md): Invite people to your Chirp home and pick which sensors, dashboards, and automations they can use.
- [Accepting Invitations](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/account/accepting-invitations.md): Join someone's Chirp home from the email link, and learn how membership and ownership invitations differ.
- [Managing Access](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/account/managing-access.md): Update what each household member can see and do, or remove someone from your Chirp home.
- [Home Settings](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/account/organization-settings.md): Rename your Chirp home or hand ownership to someone else, available only to the home owner.
- [Switching Homes](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/account/switching-organizations.md): Move between multiple Chirp homes, like your house and a cabin, without signing out.
- [Changelog](https://docs.chirpwireless.io/changelog.md): Chirp changelog — Flight Log entries for every release, with feature highlights and links to the matching guides.

# Agent Instructions
This documentation is published with GitBook. GitBook is the documentation platform designed so that both humans and AI agents can read, navigate, and reason over technical content effectively. Learn more at gitbook.com.

## Querying This Documentation
If you need additional information, you can query the documentation dynamically by asking a question.
Perform an HTTP GET request on a page URL with the `ask` query parameter:
```
GET https://docs.chirpwireless.io/readme.md?ask=<question>
```
The question should be specific, self-contained, and written in natural language.
The response will contain a direct answer to the question and relevant excerpts and sources from the documentation.
Use this mechanism when the answer is not explicitly present in the current page, you need clarification or additional context, or you want to retrieve related documentation sections.
